name: Ansirem's Key

narrative.details:
The mage that is in possession of the Stone is amplifying its power through some focal point... an altar of some sort. You should be able to disrupt it by overpowering it.

As it happens, I know just the thing: an ancient dagger, another troll relic. There's just one... little problem.

You see, I found the dagger while researching in Stranglethorn, but I gave it to my willful daughter, Catelyn, who ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate.
narrative.objectives: Talk to Catelyn in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText:
My dagger? What are you, some sort of comedian?

What? Do you just want me to repeat the story of how I've gone from the best knife fighter in Booty Bay to the laughing stock of piratedom!

I lost a knife fight to one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers--bunch of right bastards they are!--and he took my blade as spoils.

It's not as though I can get by as a knife fighter with insults and a sharp tongue alone...

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 37 to 40, 14,190 XP in all.

quests.name: The Haunted Isle
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

quests.name: The Stone of the Tides
quests.objectiveText: Find the haunted island for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Water Elementals
quests.objectiveText: Acquire 6 Water Elemental Bracers for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Magical Analysis
quests.objectiveText: Bring the water elemental bracers to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in Dalaran.

quests.name: Ansirem's Key
quests.objectiveText: Talk to Catelyn in Booty Bay.

quests.name: "Pretty Boy" Duncan
quests.objectiveText: Get Catelyn's dagger from "Pretty Boy" Duncan.

quests.name: The Curse of the Tides
quests.objectiveText: Destroy the Altar of the Tides with Catelyn's Blade, kill Gazban and bring the Stone of the Tides and Catelyn's Blade back to Baron Revilgaz.
